Because the text is strictly administrative and devoid of risk discussion, there is no basis to extract or score pandemic-related risk statements. Consequently, under the Time Decay Principle and the methodology’s requirement to score only actual evidence, the appropriate outcome is an empty evidence list with no risk score assigned.
